facts.content: Patient presents with diarrhea for 3 days.
Patient reports watery diarrhea with 5 to 6 stools per day for 3 days.
The illness began with vomiting, which has now resolved.
facts.source_text: Began with vomiting (now resolved), then persistent diarrhea.

facts.content: There has been no visible blood in the stool.
Patient reports no significant abdominal pain.
Patient feels dehydrated.
Patient is unable to drink fluids without needing to go to the bathroom quickly.
facts.source_text: unable to drink fluids without quick bathroom trips;

facts.content: Patient reports poor oral intake.
Patient reports reduced appetite.
There was initially a mild fever.
Patient now feels weak but is not currently febrile.
facts.source_text: now feeling weak but not febrile.

facts.content: Patient reports no other systemic symptoms.
Patient has a history of asthma.
Patient uses an inhaled short-acting blue beta-agonist as needed.
Patient has no known allergies.
Patient's father had hypertension.
Patient's father had bowel cancer and died about 10 years ago.
facts.source_text: Father – hypertension; bowel cancer (died ~10 yrs ago).

facts.content: Patient's mother has type 2 diabetes.
Patient lives alone.
Patient works as a software engineer.
Patient has been off work for several days.
Patient drinks alcohol infrequently.
Patient is a non-smoker.
Assessment includes acute gastroenteritis.
There is a risk of dehydration secondary to poor fluid intake with watery diarrhea.
facts.source_text: 2. Risk of dehydration secondary to poor fluid intake with watery diarrhea

facts.content: Asthma is stable on as-needed inhaler.
Start oral rehydration with Diurelite for hydration.
facts.source_text: Hydration: Start oral rehydration with Diurelite

facts.content: Use paracetamol as needed for fever or weakness.
facts.source_text: Symptom relief: Paracetamol as needed for fever/weakness

facts.content: Patient to remain off work for the next day or two and re-evaluate after being diarrhea-free for 24 to 48 hours before returning to work.
facts.source_text: Activity/work: Continue off work for next day or two; re-evaluate after diarrhea-free for 24–48 hours before returning to work

facts.content: Patient is advised to eat small, tolerable solid foods and to encourage fluid intake.
facts.source_text: Diet: Small, tolerable solids; encourage fluids

facts.content: If symptoms are not improving by next week, the patient should return for re-evaluation.
facts.source_text: Follow-up: If not improving by next week, return for re-evaluation
